title: How to use the self clean button on a steam iron

pieces.say: Your iron has a secret self-clean button.
pieces.text: Your iron has a secret self-clean button.
pieces.label: HIDDEN SETTING

pieces.say: Here's the hidden setting. It's called self-clean or calc-clean.
Fill it, heat to max, then unplug.
Hold it flat over the sink.
Press and hold the button, and shake gently.
Reheat, and iron an old towel dry.
Hot steam, so keep your hands clear. Water only.
No more white flakes on your shirts.

result.say: No more white flakes on your shirts.
result.headline: Flake-free soleplate

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
